purpose: Define falsifiable, personally operable-in-principle domestic securities and futures research hypotheses while preserving an open domestic listed universe. This artifact is not a product admission, allocation, holding, transaction instruction, performance result or return guarantee.

return_hurdle.label: strict_ex_post_research_hurdle_only
return_hurdle.assessment_scope: At the combined-strategy level, every complete calendar year's net TWRR must be at least 5%, and every eligible rolling five-year endpoint's annualized net TWRR must be at least 5%, including the predeclared primary out-of-sample window.
required_accounting: All verified fees, taxes, spreads, market impact, no-fill, settlement, corporate-action, margin and collateral effects.
All endpoint failures and data revisions retained.
No unpublished substitution of a continuous future, an adjusted-price assumption or an unavailable execution price.
return_hurdle.non_inference: Passing a historical hurdle would not guarantee, forecast, set a floor for, or assign a probability to future returns.

cashflow_boundary.treatment: Coupons, interest, fund distributions, redemption and corporate actions must be recorded once in the future total-return ledger at their actual event time. A future withdrawal requires a separate time-weighted-return subperiod.

suitability_rule.title: CSRC Measures for the Suitability Management of Securities and Futures Investors
controls: Personal suitability, product permission and broker route cannot be inferred by the research process.
Uncertain outcomes cannot be expressed as determinate judgments or guarantees.

exchange_discovery_routes.scope: R01-R17 are official or first-party discovery/inquiry routes only. They do not evidence point-in-time entitlement, complete historical coverage, execution capability or a personal trading permission.

common_formal_replay_controls.requirement: Freeze U0, then derive T2 with a pre-outcome, class-neutral rule. Retain listed, delisted, expired, suspended, renamed, terminated and no-fill items in the historical record.

Every input needs as_of, available_at, source revision, raw hash and written usage/retention right. Retrospective public pages, public continuous futures and unexplained adjusted fund prices are not substitutes.
Orders, partial fills, no fills, fees, taxes, settlement, margin, collateral, debit and corporate actions must enter the formal ledger. Futures notional is exposure only, not portfolio NAV.
Parameters, development window, lockbox out-of-sample window, execution timestamp, roll logic and risk limits must be signed before the corresponding outcome is viewed.
Product facts, account permission, broker route and suitability must be separately evidenced. No research output may assume an individual can trade an instrument.

hypotheses.title: A-share quality-trend cross-sectional selection
hypotheses.research_question: In a complete point-in-time domestic A-share population, can joint ranking of earnings quality, balance-sheet resilience and medium-term trend improve return/drawdown characteristics after real trading frictions versus a broad equity exposure?
hypotheses.economic_logic: The market may price changes in earnings quality, financial resilience and trend with a delay. The hypothesis fails if information is incorporated quickly, accounting factors cease to work, liquidity constraints dominate or industry concentration explains the result.

eligibility: Effective listed and trading-status record on the decision date.
Sufficient lagged, publication-timestamped accounting data for every factor.
Tradability under the frozen execution model.
admissible_instruments.recording_rule: Missing data, halted status, special status, impending termination or no-fill condition is retained with a dated exclusion reason; it is not silently removed.

selection_and_ranking.frequency: Monthly, on the final valid valuation day.

factor_score.name: medium_term_trend
factor_score.definition: Cross-sectional percentile of total return from t-252 through t-21; higher is better.

factor_score.name: earnings_quality
factor_score.definition: Industry-normalized percentile composite of lagged operating-cash-flow-to-net-income, ROIC and earnings stability; higher is better.

factor_score.name: financial_resilience
factor_score.definition: Industry-normalized inverse percentile composite of accruals, net-debt pressure and dilution; lower raw values are better.

selection_and_ranking.selection: Retain the top decile of composite scores. If fewer than 20 names qualify, record low coverage and do not relax the rule.
selection_and_ranking.weighting: Inverse-volatility starting weights, with a maximum of 30 names, 8% of NAV per issuer and 30% of NAV per industry. Any constraint-created residual must stay explicit in the execution ledger.

entry_exit_rebalance.signal_timing: Generate after month-end close with only data available by that cutoff.
entry_exit_rebalance.entry: Attempt at the next eligible trading session using the frozen broker time window, marketable-limit rule and no-fill state.
exit: Loss of eligibility or a relevant corporate-action/status risk event.
A predeclared issuer, industry, liquidity, concentration or portfolio-volatility risk rule.

risk_limits.failure_treatment: A non-computable or breached risk constraint fails the endpoint; it cannot be repaired by hindsight resizing.

transaction_tax_slippage_requirements: Dated broker commission, exchange/settlement and tax/levy terms.
Minimum order unit, price-limit, halt, trading-calendar and T+1 evidence.
Bid/ask or conservative reconstructible execution data, including partial fills and no fills.
Dated corporate-action, delisting and settlement ledger.
operational_constraints: No account access, tax treatment or product permission is assumed.
Historical fees and levies must use their effective-date terms.
A restricted sale or delayed settlement remains unresolved until the formal ledger records it.
falsifiers: Net primary out-of-sample results fail the frozen module standard or the combined strategy fails the strict ex-post 5% hurdle.
The result appears only after deleted delistings, halts, special-status names, no-fills or corporate actions.
Permitted execution-window, liquidity-assumption or threshold variants are unstable across independent windows.
Stress, execution replay, suitability or route verification fails.
why_not_usable_now: No accepted A-share point-in-time population, accounting availability, corporate-action, trading-status or execution/cost ledger exists.
No parameter freeze, formal replay, holdout result or paper reconciliation exists.
No issuer candidate or trading instruction is admitted.

hypotheses.title: Actual-contract domestic commodity and financial futures trend module
hypotheses.research_question: Across all eligible actual domestic commodity and financial futures contracts, can one consistent trend, contract-selection, roll and risk-budget process produce a return source distinct from equity and rate securities after daily margining and costs?
hypotheses.economic_logic: Trend may reflect persistent inventory, demand, macro-risk and risk-transfer shifts, but can fail in range-bound markets, limit moves, policy shocks, basis distortion and roll cost.

admissible_instruments.population_rule: Include all domestic actual listed contracts by venue and lifecycle. Do not replace the population with continuous contracts, ex-post main contracts or the AU/CU/TA probes.
admissible_instruments.contract_selector: For each product on each weekly signal day, choose one candidate at least max(15 sessions, the contemporaneously effective contract-specific delivery buffer) from last trade/delivery among eligible contracts. Rank candidates by prior-20-session verified turnover and open interest. If none qualifies, that product is unheld.
admissible_instruments.options_boundary: Listed options are not base-H2 positions. They can be researched only as a separately admitted risk-transfer extension with full chain, exercise/assignment, margin, volatility and payoff accounting.

selection_and_ranking.frequency: Weekly, after the final eligible settlement.
selection_and_ranking.trend_score: 0.5 times the standardized 63-session settlement-price return plus 0.5 times the standardized 252-session settlement-price return.
selection_and_ranking.direction_rule: Positive score permits long only; negative score permits short only; absolute score below 0.25 standard deviations permits no new position.
selection_and_ranking.weighting: Inverse 20-session realized-volatility weights, first normalized by product then scaled by the risk budget. Daily reconstruction must retain contract code, direction, score, roll reason and input cutoff.

entry_exit_rebalance.entry: Attempt in the next eligible session through the frozen limit-price, participation and no-fill model.
exit_or_roll: Absolute trend score below 0.10 standard deviations.
Loss of liquidity or delivery-buffer eligibility.
entry_exit_rebalance.roll_accounting: Closing the old contract and opening the new one are separate transactions; a continuous series cannot conceal the roll.

risk_limits.margin_and_stress_limit: Initial margin plus two largest historical adverse daily variation-margin moves must not exceed 35% of NAV.

transaction_tax_slippage_requirements: Daily actual-contract master, settlement, turnover, open interest, price limit, market status, multiplier and tick.
Effective-dated fees, margins, position limits, delivery terms, settlement rules and broker charges.
Actual trade/no-fill, margin-call and all-session calendar evidence.
Daily variation-margin and final-settlement accounting with notional as exposure only.
operational_constraints: Personal suitability, product permission, broker route, eligible contracts and delivery path must be confirmed externally at the relevant time.
Night sessions, holidays and cross-date sessions use venue calendars rather than a static clock.
No naked short option exposure is permitted in the base module.
falsifiers: Actual-contract, roll, margin and cost-aware results fail the frozen module standard or the combined strategy fails the strict ex-post 5% hurdle.
Results depend on continuous futures, ex-post contract choice, unrecorded night-session prices, zero slippage or ignored delivery risk.
A stress endpoint cannot settle because of margin, limit move or no fill but is nevertheless reported as passing.
A product, account permission or broker route cannot be evidenced.
why_not_usable_now: Existing evidence is limited retrospective commodity source-path sampling, not a complete actual-contract population.
Financial-futures data, historical rules/margins, broker execution, suitability and roll ledgers are unaccepted.
No futures contract, risk budget or transaction action is admitted.

hypotheses.title: REIT, bond, convertible and listed-fund valuation-trend rotation
hypotheses.research_question: After class-specific economic and total-return modeling, can REITs, exchange-listed bonds/convertibles and listed equity/bond/money-market/commodity ETFs be selected by valuation, income quality, trend, premium/discount and liquidity more robustly than a single rate exposure?
hypotheses.economic_logic: Yield labels, coupons, distributions and low-volatility marketing are not return evidence. Rates, credit, asset operations, conversion terms, premium/discount, commodity prices and liquidity can deteriorate together.

admissible_instruments.admission_rule: Each class needs an independent accepted data package and product-diligence package before it can contribute a candidate. No class is presumed defensive.

selection_and_ranking.frequency: Monthly, on the final valid valuation day.

within_class_scores.formula: 40% market-price-to-verifiable-NAV premium/discount quality + 30% underlying-operating trend + 20% six-month total-return trend + 10% liquidity.
40% maturity/credit/accrual-adjusted yield quality + 25% price trend + 20% term-and-credit-event quality + 15% liquidity.
35% complete-terms valuation using bond floor, conversion value and premium + 30% issuer credit/operating quality + 20% trend + 15% liquidity.
35% holdings/duration/credit/accrual-adjusted yield quality + 25% trend + 20% NAV-premium/discount quality + 20% liquidity.
35% index-look-through quality/concentration + 35% medium-term total-return trend + 15% NAV-premium/discount quality + 15% liquidity.
50% medium-term total-return trend + 25% NAV-premium/discount quality + 25% liquidity and underlying-market availability.

selection_and_ranking.cross_class_selection: Convert valid within-class scores to percentiles, retain only the top quartile of each class, then select the top-scoring maximum of 12 securities across the survivors.
selection_and_ranking.weighting: Inverse 60-session total-return volatility, with 15% of NAV maximum per issuer/manager, 35% per class and 35% per REIT underlying-asset type. These are caps, not current allocations or minimum holdings.

entry_exit_rebalance.entry: Signal at month-end; attempt next eligible trading day under the frozen broker execution rule.
exit: Security falls below the top half of its class.
Loss of data or trading eligibility.
Corporate action, fund suspension, redemption, put/call, conversion, maturity, REIT expansion or material underlying-asset event triggers revalidation.
entry_exit_rebalance.cashflow_rule: No distribution, interest, cash-balance or automatic-reinvestment objective exists. Actual events enter only the accepted total-return, settlement and unitization ledger.

risk_limits.failure_treatment: Missing data for a required stress or a breach fails the endpoint.

transaction_tax_slippage_requirements: Full historical product/security population, market price, NAV or accumulated NAV, IOPV, holdings and index methodology.
Coupon, distribution, redemption, put, call, conversion, maturity, expansion and credit-event ledger.
Clean/dirty price/accrual, underlying REIT operational data, trading status, quote depth, effective-dated fees and levies.
Separate reconciliation of market-price and NAV total return.
operational_constraints: Personal market access, order size, settlement timing, T+1, trading units, costs and product risk grade are time-specific external facts.
Static yield, a single curve observation or promotional fund material cannot substitute for total-return and execution evidence.
SSE/SZSE and manager public pages can support discovery and later rule review but are not accepted replay inputs by themselves.
falsifiers: Event-complete market-price/NAV total return after costs fails the frozen module standard or the combined strategy fails the strict ex-post 5% hurdle.
Results exist only after omitted distributions, redemption, credit events, conversions, halts or premium/discount stress.
Bond, convertible or REIT economic inputs are not available at the model timestamp.
Depth, fees, taxes, settlement or suitability cannot support the simulated execution.
why_not_usable_now: No full population, event ledger, REIT operating record, bond/convertible terms and credit-event record, fund total-return or real execution record has been accepted.
No product list, allocation, purchase instruction or defensive/cash-equivalent conclusion is admitted.

research_sequence_before_any_product_lev: Complete source, rights and required-field inquiries for all ten U0 classes.
Freeze each module's parameters, universe, benchmark, development period, lockbox period and execution model without viewing the result.
Run all-history and holdout replays including costs, taxes, no fills, settlement, margin and corporate actions; retain all endpoints.
Complete at least 60 calendar days and 10 observations of paper reconciliation with independent review of fills, fees, taxes, settlement, margin and risk state.
Only after data, replay, paper reconciliation, risk veto and suitability pass may a separate product-diligence or research-action discussion occur.

current_blockers.fact: UR01-UR05 remain open; no accepted class-level point-in-time raw package exists.
No signed U0/T2, rulebook or formal replay-run freeze exists.
current_blockers.effect: No return, ranking or selection result may be calculated.

current_blockers.fact: No broker route, historical cost/fee/tax, depth, fill/no-fill or settlement evidence has been accepted.
current_blockers.effect: A theoretical signal cannot be called personally operable.

current_blockers.fact: No product/contract, issuer, terms, delivery, exercise or underlying-asset diligence is complete.
current_blockers.effect: No named instrument or weight may be admitted.

current_blockers.fact: No personal suitability or account permission has been verified.
current_blockers.effect: No futures, option, bond or complex-product access can be assumed.

current_blockers.fact: No cost-aware holdout result or prospective paper reconciliation exists.
current_blockers.effect: No 5% claim and no claim of stability is permitted.

current_decision: The case now has a broader, falsifiable research architecture rather than a convenience-sample product list. It still has no usable strategy, approved instrument, allocation, holding, order, execution instruction or return conclusion.
